_comment: Protagonist generation pool (spec A2). Name pools, surnames, stations, backstory flavor/epilogue text, and the name-index -> portrait-key map. Backstory text uses controlled {slots} resolved at render time: {name}/{Name}, {pronoun}/{Pronoun} (subject: she/he), {pronoun_obj}/{Pronoun_obj} (her/him), {pronoun_poss}/{Pronoun_poss} (her/his), {station}/{Station}. Subject pronouns are only used in modal/past constructions so she/he both agree.

backstories.title: Water Systems Transfer
backstories.flavor: Former water reclamation tech. Transferred to relay work after {station}'s filtration cascade three years ago. Knows pressure differentials and pump architecture better than most engineers. Took the relay cert because standing around watching gauges wasn't cutting it anymore.

epilogue.correction: The filtration knowledge from {station} paid off twice today.
epilogue.destruction: Another cascade. This time, {pronoun} couldn't stop it at the source.

backstories.title: Tunnel Surveyor
backstories.flavor: Former tunnel surveyor for the eastern expansion project. Mapped twelve kilometers of unmaintained corridor before the project was shelved. Reassigned to relay maintenance because the corps needed bodies and {pronoun} already knew the tunnels.

epilogue.correction: Twelve kilometers of survey work and it led here. Worth it.
epilogue.destruction: The maps were right. The destination was wrong.

backstories.title: Apprentice Legacy
backstories.flavor: Apprentice-trained under RELAY-4, the last tech who tried to trace the infrastructure failures to their source. RELAY-4 went into the eastern maintenance network nine months ago and didn't come back. Dispatch listed it as a structural collapse. The relay corps doesn't talk about it.

epilogue.correction: RELAY-4 would have done the same thing. Maybe {pronoun} tried.

backstories.title: Station-Born
backstories.flavor: Born at {station}. {Name} left to join the relay corps at seventeen because the station walls were closing in. {Station} is still home. The people there still wave when {pronoun} passes through on rotation.

epilogue.correction: {Station}'s lights are still on. That's what matters.
epilogue.destruction: {Station} is dark. {Pronoun} could see it from here.

backstories.title: Infrastructure Lineage
backstories.flavor: Third generation infrastructure. Grandmother was a power systems engineer before the collapse. The diagnostic tools in the kit are inherited. The instinct for tracing faults through complex systems might be too.

epilogue.correction: Three generations of keeping the lights on. Still holding.
epilogue.destruction: Grandmother built things that lasted. This wasn't one of them.

backstories.title: Walk-In
backstories.flavor: Walked in from the southern tunnel network three years ago. No station of origin on file. The relay corps took {pronoun_obj} because {pronoun} could already read a schematic and the corps doesn't ask questions. Dispatch suspects {pronoun} came from somewhere that doesn't exist anymore.

epilogue.correction: {Pronoun} came from a place that died. This one didn't have to.
epilogue.destruction: {Pronoun} came from a place that died. This one did too.
